newsitem.title: USA: Cooperative Computing extends Triad offer.
newsitem.headline: Cooperative Computing extends Triad offer.

text.p: Cooperative Computing Inc and its affiliate, CCI Acquisition Corp, said they have extended a tender offer to acquire all the shares of Triad Systems Corp at $9.25 a share to January 27 at 1000 EST/1500 GMT.
The offer was set to expire today at 1000 EST/1500 GMT, the companies said in a statement issued late on Thursday.
In addition, the companies extended several other dates.
The final date to complete the tender offer has been extended to February 20. The final date to complete the merger was extended to the 45th day after the consummation of the tender offer.
Finally, Chase Manhattan Corp's Chase Manhattan Bank has extended its commitment to provide debt financing through Feb. 20.

The terms of the extended tender offer are identical to those in the original tender offer. The dates were extended primarily to provide more time to resolve issues raised by the Federal Trade Commission in connection with its review.
Cooperative Computing said it is optimistic that all such outstanding issues will be satisfactorily resolved.
As of 1700 EST on Jan. 16, about 86 percent of Triad's issued and outstanding shares had been tendered, it said.
